caption: The video captures a low-angle view looking up through a forest canopy, where dark tree trunks cross the scene and backlit green leaves fill the edges. The sun is already shining through the foliage, producing a broad white glare and a magenta lens-flare patch in the lower left. As the viewpoint drifts slowly, the trunks shift relative to the edges of the scene, and the central diagonal branch appears to pass across the sun. The bright glare contracts into a small starburst partly hidden behind that branch, while the purple flare fades. The drift continues, and the sun re-emerges around the branch, broadening and contracting again before settling into an intense white wash. This glare spreads through the upper center, softening leaf detail and turning the trunks into darker silhouettes. The flare returns again and enlarges in the lower left as the bright sky dominates the view.
relations: Viewpoint drift causes dark trunks to shift relative to the scene edges.
Branch occluding the sun contracts the glare into a starburst and fades the purple flare.
Sun re-emerging broadens the glare and enlarges the magenta lens-flare patch in the lower left.
Bright glare spreading through the canopy softens leaf detail and darkens the trunk silhouettes.
